description: Returns TypeScript declarations (.d.ts) for this server's tools: an argument interface per tool, a ToolName union, and one overloaded callTool signature per callable tool. Fetch this BEFORE authoring a script or a multi-step plan against these tools -- it turns a wrong argument shape into a compile-time error instead of a runtime tool failure you have to decode from an error string. Generated from the same schemas the server validates against, so it cannot drift. Tools hidden by the active profile are still declared and marked @profileHidden rather than omitted. Read-only: makes no Premiere request.

includeHidden.description: Declare tools the active profile hides, marked @profileHidden (default true)

only.description: Restrict output to these tool names. Omit for the whole catalogue (large - prefer find_tool first, then request typings for the handful you need).

name: get_tool_typings
